Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Outfit: a mummy costume — a fitted bandage-wrap mini dress of layered cream gauze strips, bare shoulders and loose trailing wrap ends, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body facing the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly below, looking up at her.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — calcium: the element living things build their bodies with — bone and teeth, seashells and pearls with a pink-and-silver nacre sheen; limestone cliffs laid down by countless shells, white marble statues, chalk, stalactites dripping for ten thousand years; pale, strong and patient — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.
